_note: Which volume slider every sound plays under. A cue name is looked up in 'exact' first, then by the longest matching 'prefix', else it plays on 'default'. Every bus is scaled by MASTER; HUNTERS, AMBIENCE and MUSIC also sit under GAMEPLAY (sfx); UI is master only. 'labels' are the settings captions (shown in upper case). A new cue needs no entry unless it belongs to a bus other than the default; audio/cues/bus_tests.rs fails if an entry names a bus that does not exist.
